description: This file contains unit tests for the Abseil library's mocking of random number generators, specifically testing the mocking and expectations of the 'absl::MockingBitGen' class and related functions.

classes.name: absl::MockingBitGen
classes.description: A mock class for the random bit generator used in testing to override random distributions.

methods.name: EXPECT_CALL
methods.description: Sets expectations on mocked methods, such as Call() with specific arguments.

methods.name: ON_CALL
methods.description: Sets default behavior for mocked methods.

methods.name: WillOnce
methods.description: Specifies the return value or action for a single call expectation.

methods.name: WillByDefault
methods.description: Specifies default behavior for mocked methods when no specific expectation is set.

methods.name: RetiresOnSaturation
methods.description: Indicates that the expectation should be retired after a certain number of calls.
